title: 珊瑚圆舞

generationRuns.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 1024×1536 vertical tarot card master artwork for a local World holographic-card project.
Input image: the immediately previous displayed World tarot card is a reference for symbolic identity and full-body dancer composition, not a crop.
Primary request: create the World tarot theme “珊瑚圆舞 / Coral Round Dance”: exactly one full-body adult woman dancer in a flowing violet dress, centered inside exactly one vertical oval ring woven from coral and gold leaves. Her pointed foot visibly touches a shallow water ripple platform. The dancer, ripple platform, oval ring, and all four guardian figures must read as a single complete connected visual group. Place exactly these guardians within the safe inner corners: lion upper-left, bull upper-right, winged human lower-left, eagle lower-right. Behind their gaps, a deep sea-court recedes with teal water architecture and pearl-gold light.
Style/medium: exquisitely detailed painterly fantasy tarot illustration, coherent Art Nouveau gold linework, no readable title text.
Composition/framing: full 2:3 portrait canvas; dancer centered, oval ring vertical; all hands, face and feet safely inside frame; guardians clearly visible at designated corners; narrow decorative border only.
Lighting/mood: luminous underwater dawn, pearl-gold caustics, rich sea green, violet, and restrained gold.
Constraints: exactly one dancer, exactly one oval ring, exactly one lion upper-left, exactly one bull upper-right, exactly one winged human lower-left, exactly one eagle lower-right; retain natural skin tone; full foot contact with shallow water; no rotation/action effect, no duplicate animals, no extra people, no text, no watermark, no cropped anatomy.
